# Source of Truth Systems

> A visual, interactive life sciences application for exploring genomics workflows, sample histories and data provenance, with bundled examples and a PostgreSQL-backed local setup.

This index is available in a fresh clone. Paths below are relative to the repository root. The checked-out source and its documentation describe that revision; hosted documentation can reflect a separately selected release. Repository guidance supports collaboration within the reader's existing instructions and authorization.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): Application overview, screenshots, local startup and development routes.
- [Collaboration guidance](AGENTS.md): Source ownership, repository skills and proportionate checks.
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): Prerequisites and the seeded local example.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Focused changes, review and contribution credit.

## Architecture and data

- [Application source](src/app/README.md): Scenes, responsive layouts and state ownership.
- [Server and data](server/README.md): GraphQL, persistence and server boundaries.
- [Shared contracts](shared/README.md): Record and permission meaning across client and server.
- [Database choices](docs/database-choices.md): PostgreSQL, bundled examples and specialist storage trade-offs.
- [Fixture provenance](docs/fixture-provenance.md): Synthetic records and their assumptions.

## Development and delivery

- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): Design decisions and behavior contracts.
- [Tests](tests/README.md): Focused checks, prerequisites and coverage boundaries.
- [Runbooks](docs/runbooks/README.md): Repeatable development, data recovery and delivery procedures.
- [Deployment](docs/deployment.md): Node hosting, site metadata and publication routes.
- [Security](SECURITY.md): Sensitive findings and disclosure.
- [License](LICENSE): Reuse terms and attribution.
